questions.title: Ensure Execution
questions.description: What does the following code print?
questions.codesnippet:
def m
  begin
    return 1
  ensure
    puts "ran"
  end
end
puts m

questions.title: Else After No Exception
questions.description: What does the following code print?
questions.codesnippet:
begin
  x = 5
rescue => e
  puts "rescued"
else
  puts "else ran"
ensure
  puts "ensured"
end

questions.title: Re-raise Behavior
questions.description: What does the following code print?
questions.codesnippet:
def outer
  inner
rescue ZeroDivisionError
  puts "outer caught"
end
def inner
  begin
    1 / 0
  rescue ZeroDivisionError
    puts "inner caught"
    raise
  end
end
outer

questions.title: Custom Exception Match
questions.description: What does the following code print?
questions.codesnippet:
class MyError < StandardError; end
begin
  raise MyError, "boom"
rescue ArgumentError
  puts "AE"
rescue MyError => e
  puts "ME: #{e.message}"
end

questions.title: Ensure with Return
questions.description: If a `return` is executed inside a `begin` block, does `ensure` still run?
questions.Option3: Only if begin is nested in a method

questions.title: Retry Counter
questions.description: What does the following code print?
questions.codesnippet:
attempts = 0
begin
  attempts += 1
  raise "fail" if attempts < 2
  puts "succeeded on #{attempts}"
rescue => e
  retry if attempts < 3
  puts "gave up"
end

questions.title: Nested Rescue With Ensure
questions.description: What does the following code print?
questions.codesnippet:
def m
  begin
    begin
      raise "inner"
    rescue
      puts "inner rescue"
      raise "outer"
    end
  rescue => e
    puts "outer rescue: #{e.message}"
  ensure
    puts "outer ensure"
  end
end
m

questions.title: Exception Hierarchy Catch Order
questions.description: What does the following code print?
questions.codesnippet:
class AppError < StandardError; end
class SubError < AppError; end
begin
  raise SubError
rescue AppError
  puts "AppError caught"
rescue SubError
  puts "SubError caught"
end

questions.title: Rescue Returns Value
questions.description: What does the following code print?
questions.codesnippet:
result = begin
  raise "oops"
rescue => e
  "recovered"
end
